tagline: What Claude touched, and a replay of what it changed

features.title: File tree
features.detail: Only the files Claude read, edited, wrote or created this session, in folders you can fold, with +/- line counts for edits.

features.title: Live marker
features.detail: While Claude works, the file it is on right now is lit and says what it is doing: reading, editing, writing, creating.

features.title: Replay
features.detail: Steps through the edits of the last turn one diff at a time with Prev and Next; a click on a file in the tree opens its latest diff.

actions.label: Clear the tree and the replay
